component.name: ZERAVRIX
component.summary: High-performance Manga and Webtoon Reader for PC

description.p: ZERAVRIX is an open-source, high-performance desktop manga and webtoon reader built with Compose Multiplatform. It offers smooth vertical webtoon scrolling, multi-page horizontal reading, smart memory management, and local offline library support.

ul.li: Optimized memory caching with background prefetching and automatic cleanup
Vertical Webtoon, Horizontal Single Page, and Double Page spreads
Local CBZ and folder archive support with fast image decompression
Clean desktop interface with customizable keyboard shortcuts
Optimized image caching and dynamic heap memory management
Enhanced reader navigation and keyboard shortcuts
Desktop stability and multi-format reading fixes
